violations.affected_code: padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 10, bottom: 10, left: label == null ? 10 : 16, right: label == null ? 10 : 20) ... Icon(icon, size: 28, ...)
violations.explanation: In the icon-only variant, the tappable area is 28 + 10 + 10 = 48dp, which just meets the minimum. Height is also 48dp. This is borderline acceptable, but the GestureDetector has no minimum-size constraint. Note that Row has mainAxisSize max by default, so width may expand. Overall the size likely meets 48dp, so this is low confidence.

Both semanticsLabel and label are optional. The icon-only variant can therefore be built with neither, producing a button with no accessible name. Because excludeSemantics is true, no fallback name is available from the child widgets.
